title: Grateful Dead Live at Kezar Stadium on 1973-05-26
lineage: Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard> HD Editing performed in Adobe Audition; Flac Encoded
source: Recording by Gene Taback: Master Audience Cassette; Sony TC-124 with Sony Stereo Mic

ai_review.summary: Lo‑Fi soundboard capture with clear vocals, Jerry’s guitar and a bit of bass punch, but narrow stereo field and low fidelity
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as a top‑sounding soundboard source despite its lo‑fi character; the mix is clear enough to hear Jerry’s lead guitar, Phil’s bass punch and Bob’s rhythm work, though the stereo image is narrow and overall fidelity is modest. No specific musical moments are highlighted, so the show itself is presented as an average arena performance with a decent vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate‑rating review; comments focus on recording quirks more than musical excellence, leading to an average overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocals and guitars, bass has some punch, but stereo field is narrow and fidelity low; occasional hand‑clap/cheer bleed is unobtrusive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing

band_member_comments.Jerry: Clear lead guitar and vocal presence noted
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass has a little punch according to reviewer
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar audible in the mix
